---
title: "Guides"
description: "Tutorials, how-to guides, and background for working with HornDB."
---

Guides are the task-and-learning side of the HornDB docs. They come in three
kinds, and each page stays in exactly one:

- **Tutorials** take you along a single guided path to a first success.
- **How-to guides** give the steps to reach one real-world result.
- **Explanation** discusses *why* — the design decisions and trade-offs.

For exact syntax — SPARQL functions, config keys, error codes — see the
[Reference](../ref/index.qmd) instead.

## Start here

- [Getting started](getting-started.qmd) — load a small dataset, turn on OWL 2 RL
  reasoning, and get your first inferred answer.
